en: \bDrayden may be gone, but I can help you prepare for a fight against him.
it: \bAristide non c'è, ma posso aiutarti a prepararti per affrontarlo.

id: \bWant to learn Dual Chop?
en: \bWant to learn Dual Chop?
it: \bVuoi imparare Doppiocolpo?

id: \bCome back anytime!
en: \bCome back anytime!
it: \bTorna quando vuoi!

id: \rDrayden must be thinking hard about his last battle. He's already left for training.
en: \rDrayden must be thinking hard about his last battle.  He's already left for training.
it: \rAristide deve star riflettendo molto sulla sua ultima lotta.  È già partito per allenarsi.

id: \bDrayden is not taking challenges right now.
en: \bDrayden is not taking challenges right now.

id: \rMaybe you can help.
en: \rMaybe you can help.
it: \rForse tu puoi aiutarmi.

en: \rDo you know Iris? She's a good friend of mine.
it: \rConosci Iris? È una mia cara amica.

en: \rThe Village of Dragons is close to here, but I can't tell a stranger exactly where it is.

en: Opelucid City\nTime's Dividing Line
it: Boreduopoli\nLa linea che divide il tempo

id: \bWe don't get many visitors here. Welcome.
en: \bWe don't get many visitors here. Welcome.
it: \bQui non riceviamo molti visitatori. Benvenuto.

en: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Goh:

en: \bGoh: \PN, Professor Oak called and invited us to visit him at his lab. I'll be waiting for you there.
it: \bGoh: \PN, il Professor Oak ha chiamato e ci ha invitati a fargli visita al suo laboratorio. Ti aspetto lì.

id: \bThe Vetress Conference is done. Come back next year.
en: \bThe Vetress Conference is done. Come back next year.

en: Opelucid City Pokémon Gym Leader:\nDrayden

en: The Spartan Mayor
it: Il sindaco spartano

id: \bAre you here for the league? It's north of here.
en: \bAre you here for the league? It's north of here.
it: \bSei qui per la Lega? Si trova a nord di qui.

id: \rTake the time to appreciate what's around you. Someone made it what it is today, no matter how small it seems.
en: \rTake the time to appreciate what's around you.  Someone made it what it is today, no matter how small it seems.
it: \rPrenditi il tempo di apprezzare ciò che ti circonda.  Qualcuno l'ha reso ciò che è oggi, per quanto piccolo possa sembrare.

en: \bFraxure

en: \rI wonder what I should do? I don't have enough badges yet and the gym is closed.
it: \rChissà cosa dovrei fare? Non ho ancora abbastanza medaglie e la Palestra è chiusa.

id: \bSo you want to fight the Unova League winner.
en: \bSo you want to fight the Unova League winner.
it: \bQuindi vuoi sfidare il vincitore della Lega di Unima.

id: \bWonderful job.
en: \bWonderful job.
it: \bOttimo lavoro.

id: \bZwei
en: \bZwei
it: \bZwei

id: \rIris: You're here for the league, aren't you? I'm also going to guess you wanted to challenge Drayden?
en: \rIris: You're here for the league, aren't you? I'm also going to guess you wanted to challenge Drayden?
it: \rIris: Sei qui per la Lega, vero? E scommetto che volevi anche sfidare Aristide?

id: \rYeah sorry. He battled me and left right after for some training thing. I may have lost, but maybe I can be a suitable dragon master replacement.
en: \rYeah sorry. He battled me and left right after for some training thing. I may have lost, but maybe I can be a suitable dragon master replacement.
it: \rEh, mi spiace. Mi ha sfidata e poi se n'è andato subito per una specie di allenamento. Avrò anche perso, ma forse posso fare da degna sostituta come Maestra dei Draghi.

id: \rIris: Seems like you would have beat Drayden. You're maybe ready for the league. Just don't lose too quickly.
en: \rIris: Seems like you would have beat Drayden.  You're maybe ready for the league. Just don't lose too quickly.
it: \rIris: Sembra proprio che avresti battuto Aristide.  Forse sei pronto per la Lega. Basta che non perdi troppo in fretta.

id: \rYou may as well take this too.
en: \rYou may as well take this too.
it: \rTanto vale che ti prenda anche questo.

id: \rIris: You're maybe ready for the league. Just don't lose too quickly.
en: \rIris: You're maybe ready for the league. Just don't lose too quickly.
it: \rIris: Forse sei pronto per la Lega. Basta che non perdi troppo in fretta.
